flow_note: Requirements modal is the dominant flow. Search recovery and AI proposal entry are adjacent flows. This checklist is authored from the installed fallback guidance and observed app; no proprietary/live checklist coverage is claimed.

items.question: What must users accomplish?
items.evidence: brd.md and the confirm CTA require reviewing needs before recomputing the candidate list.

items.question: Which constraints are required and which can remain unknown?
items.evidence: Positive bounded budget; RAM/storage allow 0 as unknown; tasks and OS can be empty in validRequirements().

items.question: Does cancelling preserve committed needs?
items.evidence: edit() copies requirements into draft; closing changes form visibility; confirm() alone persists the new requirements.

items.question: How are errors and interrupted sessions handled?
items.evidence: Invalid values use a background notice. Modal Back exists in source, but native IME, recreation, focus and preference behavior were not tested.
items.recommendation: Use modal-local errors and define/test native interruption and recreation behavior.

postflight.summary: 3 of 8 checks pass; 3 critical failures; 2 unknown checks.

items.check: Confirmed requirements change only after explicit confirmation.
items.evidence: confirm() persists the draft and increments revision; AI proposals require a draft review.

items.check: Invalid input is explained where the user can correct it.
items.evidence: Browser budget 0 leaves modal open without an inline message; closing reveals the notice.
items.recommendation: Put field-specific error feedback inside the modal and announce it.

items.check: Selected requirements are available without relying on color.
items.evidence: RAM/storage/task choices are plain buttons without checked/selected/pressed states.
items.recommendation: Use correct roles/state and a visible non-color indicator.

items.check: Cancelling a draft preserves committed requirements.
items.evidence: Source edit() clones requirements and close only hides the form.

items.check: Budget boundaries are validated before persistence.
items.evidence: validRequirements rejects non-safe-integer, nonpositive and above-maximum budgets; associated tests passed.

items.check: Native interactive areas meet 48 dp and remain usable with IME.
items.evidence: Source sets minHeight 48; no connected Android device, no effective hit-region/IME measurements.
items.recommendation: Measure both dimensions, overlap and IME reachability on device.

items.check: Large text, TalkBack and recreation preserve operability.
items.evidence: No current native run was possible; historical verification applies to an older implementation.
items.recommendation: Run the current app with TalkBack, large fonts and configuration changes.

items.check: Persistence failure is surfaced inside the active requirements form.
items.evidence: persist() returns false and sets a notice rendered behind the modal; source-confirmed path, runtime storage failure not injected.
items.recommendation: Place save-failure feedback in the modal, retain the draft, and test retry.

api_note: UXUI_API_KEY was absent. Internal-knowledge review only; no paid API or complete live taxonomy audit was performed. See https://uxuiprinciples.com/en/checkout for optional enrichment. Flow checklists require a pro API key for live smell linkage and severity metadata.
